description: Byte-exact Linux autostart entries and platform delegation. Desktop-entry content ends with a trailing newline.

expectedFile.content:
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=ClipDeck
Comment=Clipboard manager
Exec="/opt/ClipDeck/clipdeck"
X-GNOME-Autostart-enabled=true
Hidden=false
NoDisplay=false

[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=ClipDeck
Comment=Clipboard manager
Exec="/home/user/Downloads/ClipDeck-2.0.0.AppImage"
X-GNOME-Autostart-enabled=true
Hidden=false
NoDisplay=false

notes: AppImage installs record the AppImage path, not the extracted binary (it disappears on exit).
The native binary needs no arguments, so Exec never carries an app path (v2 deviation from the Electron build).
macOS and Windows delegate to the OS login-item API; the fixture records the boolean passed.
